label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for a private great-hall event at eighteen hundred, involving food, lighting/tables and restricted access. The mayor was told of an inspection, but not the underlying purpose. A surprise gathering is plausible, not established. Builder and Freight are most directly implicated; baker and innkeeper are probable participants based on deliveries, lantern-payment discussion and reported meetings. Neighbour knowingly helped keep preparations undisturbed and escort the mayor. Secretary arranged the disclosed inspection, but knowing assistance with an undisclosed plan is not established.
